name: tablebench-tqa
description: TableBench TQA is a table question-answering benchmark that measures a model's ability to understand and reason over structured tabular data to produce correct answers to natural language questions. It evaluates comprehension of table structure, cell semantics, and simple multi-step reasoning over table contents. Primarily aimed at benchmarking tabular QA and reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A focused dataset within the table-QA community with moderate usage for assessing tabular reasoning models.
